description: Issue #1178: the shared corpus for the change-set and bundle digests defined in apply-change-set-digest.md, beside this file. @clossys/launcher is tested against every case. Expected values were produced independently of the package: a stand-alone Python 3 script (standard library only) built each change set, computed its subject by removing changeSetDigest, branch, bundle, pullRequest and inverse and reducing every file whose derived member is true to its path, mode, derived, item and invariants, serialized it with json.dumps(value, ensure_ascii=False, sort_keys=True, separators=(',', ':')) -- which is RFC 8785 for these values, because every key is ASCII (so code-point order equals UTF-16 order) and every number is a small integer, both asserted by the script -- and hashed the UTF-8 bytes with hashlib.sha256. It then set branch, the title and changeSetDigest from that digest. Bundle digests were computed the same way over planDigest and the repositories sorted by id. The script also asserted every sameDigestAs and differsFrom relation below before writing this file. valid says whether the change set also passes the contract and its code rules; every change-set digest is defined either way. Hash inputs are placeholder text: no case is a real repository, package or plan.

changeSets.name: apply-with-packages
changeSets.note: An apply-phase set: a Starter pin the base already has, two installs, a lockfile and the ledger.

changeSets.name: setup-public
changeSets.note: A setup-phase set in a public repository: the install waits for the apply phase, and a skill path already in the base is refused.

changeSets.name: staffing-only
changeSets.note: No package acts: brief, skills and the ledger only.

changeSets.name: apply-excluded-recomputed
changeSets.note: Every excluded member recomputed: the bundle, the pull request body digest, the inverse, and the lockfile's and the ledger's before and after.

changeSets.name: apply-keys-reversed
changeSets.note: Every object's members in reverse order.

changeSets.name: apply-branch-rewritten
changeSets.note: The branch, the title and the recorded digest changed. The digest does not move, and the set breaks code rule C5.

changeSets.name: apply-node-id-changed
changeSets.note: A different repository behind the same id.

changeSets.name: apply-ledger-generation
changeSets.note: The set starts from ledger generation 1.

changeSets.name: apply-package-bytes
changeSets.note: The writer package's integrity differs, in its item and its lockfile invariant.

changeSets.name: apply-staffing-changed
changeSets.note: Only the strategist is staffed here.

bundles.name: three-repositories
bundles.note: Given in staffing order; the digest sorts them by id.

bundles.name: three-repositories-reordered
bundles.note: The same repositories in another order.

bundles.name: one-repository-skipped
bundles.note: The same plan with one repository left out.

bundles.name: another-plan
bundles.note: The same change sets under another plan digest.
